title: Bluereader doesn't show predictive simulations?
body:
Hi. I use xDrip+ 2018.05.30, with FreeStyle and BlueReader.
Just yesterday I discovered the possibility to have a very useful info, i.e. the U.I. needed to recover from a high BD, based on Carb Ratio, Insulin Sensitivity and CHO Absorption Rate.
It should be shown just below the xDrip logo/name in the main page.
I gave my three values, and having BG 200 I supposed I had to see the resulting Insulin U.I. needed to recover from the high value.
As you see in the attached images, I see nothing, and the same even when I reached 228.
Am I making some mistake, or is it a bug?
Thank you.

Moreover, as you see in image 2, the BlueReader battery values in the main page have the black contour, and this makes them almost unreadable.
I'm sure there is that option, but I didn't find it, sorry.
Can you pklease address me on how to do the right change?
Thanks once again.
Bye.
Andrea :-)


![andrea-1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32884006/43320325-66deb82e-91a8-11e8-91e9-1453c2fded2b.jpg)
![andrea-2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32884006/43320326-66fc9c54-91a8-11e8-8524-40123a326457.jpg)
